rationale: F55 fixes orphan cards (linked but no MYP source) that cannot refresh prices. Two root causes: (1) matcher returns 'ambiguous' instead of best-effort pick, (2) refresh endpoint doesn't auto-canonize orphans. Low risk — pure logic fixes in matcher + endpoint fallback. Benefits 10 orphan entries immediately and improves bulk-canonize success rate for 417 unlinked entries.
